items.lede: Cyberpunk 2077 is heading to the big screen. Deadline reports that CD Projekt Red's popular sci-fi video game franchise is being adapted into a live-action film by Paramount Pictures. There's no details just yet on when the film might premiere. But Deadline says that Lorenzo di Bonaventura, who is known for producing the Transformers films, […]
items.title: Paramount is making a Cyberpunk 2077 film

items.lede: Paramount Pictures will develop the film and CD Projekt Red will produce.
items.title: Cyberpunk 2077 is the latest video game to get the movie treatment
